item.title: Introduction
item.description: What is Mach Five Magnet? Mach Five Magnet is conversational lead capture for your website. Instead of a static form, you embed a magnet: a chat bubble, slide-in panel, pop-up modal, or inline card that greets the visitor, offers them a channel, and walks them through a short guided conversation. When they finish, you get a lead: every answer, plus the campaign that brought them. You build and manage magnets in the Mach Five Magnet app.

item.title: Quickstart
item.description: Step 1: Sign up Create an account at machfivemagnet.com/app/#/signup, or log in if you already have one. Step 2: Create a magnet Go to Magnets and click New magnet. Name it, something like “Homepage quote magnet”. Enter the domain(s) it should run on, comma-separated (e.g. example.com, www.example.com). Pick a display format: chat bubble, slide-in panel, modal, or inline. Note The domain list is an allow-list, enforced server-side: the magnet only loads on domains you list here.

item.title: Concepts
item.description: Magnets A magnet is one embeddable conversational widget: a display format, an appearance, a welcome hub, and one or more flows. You create and edit magnets in the app; the embed script delivers them to your site. A page renders one magnet per display format, so a chat bubble and an inline card can coexist on the same page without touching each other. Each magnet has: A domain allow-list: the script is only served to domains you list, enforced server-side.

item.title: Integrations & data
item.description: The embed is the integration Mach Five Magnet doesn’t ask your site to talk to an API. The integration is the snippet itself: <script src="https://machfivemagnet-saas.onrender.com/m5t/v5/coreSnippet?appguid=YOUR-MAGNET-ID" async></script> When a visitor loads your page, the platform serves that script with your magnet’s current configuration (appearance, welcome hub, flows, A/B variants) already inside it. Save a change in the app and the next page load has it. There are no API keys on the page, no build step, and nothing to redeploy.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Google Ads
item.description: See ad spend lined up next to the leads it generated, so you know which campaigns are actually working. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Google Ads. Then: Click Connect and sign in with a Google account that has access to your Ads accounts. Choose which ad accounts should feed reporting. Metrics refresh automatically once a day. Click Sync now any time for an immediate pull.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Google Analytics
item.description: See how visitors reach your site and behave once they get there. Sessions, pageviews, and engagement, right alongside the leads your magnets capture. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Google Analytics. Then: Click Connect and sign in with a Google account that has access to your GA4 property. Choose which GA4 properties should feed reporting. Metrics refresh automatically once a day. Click Sync now any time for an immediate pull.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Calendly
item.description: Let visitors book directly from a magnet conversation, and get notified the moment they do. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Calendly. Then: Click Connect and authorize your Calendly account. Turn on Calendly booking for any magnet’s Book action, under Magnets. Confirmed and canceled bookings sync back to the lead automatically. Webhooks need a paid Calendly plan; a free plan still lets visitors book, just without the automatic lead sync.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and HubSpot
item.description: Every captured lead becomes a HubSpot contact automatically, with the magnet conversation on its timeline. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then HubSpot. Then: Click Connect and sign in to the HubSpot account this workspace should sync into. New leads sync as contacts within minutes. Existing contacts are updated, never duplicated. Optional: turn on qualified-lead sync to set the contact lifecycle stage when you qualify a lead.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Salesforce
item.description: Every captured lead becomes a Salesforce lead automatically, with the magnet conversation as a note on the record. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Salesforce. Then: Click Connect and sign in to the Salesforce org this workspace should sync into. New leads sync within minutes. Existing Salesforce leads are updated by email, never duplicated. Qualified-lead sync sets the Salesforce lead status. If your org uses custom status values, set yours on this page.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Zoho CRM
item.description: Every captured lead lands in the Zoho CRM Leads module automatically, with the magnet conversation as a note. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Zoho CRM. Then: Click Connect and sign in to the Zoho account this workspace should sync into. New leads sync within minutes. Existing Zoho leads are updated by email, never duplicated. Optional: turn on qualified-lead sync to set the Zoho lead status when you qualify a lead.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Microsoft Bookings
item.description: Visitors book through your Microsoft Bookings page from a magnet. Each booking is added to the lead, with the Teams meeting link included. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Microsoft Bookings. Then: Click Connect and sign in with your Microsoft 365 work account. Bookings sync to your leads every few minutes. Click Sync now for an immediate sync. Set any magnet Book button to a Bookings page, under Magnets.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and HighLevel
item.description: Every captured lead becomes a HighLevel contact automatically, with the conversation as a note and a tag your workflows can use. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then HighLevel. Then: In HighLevel, open the sub-account, go to Settings, then Private Integrations, and create a token with the contacts.write scope. Copy the sub-account Location ID from Settings, then Business Profile. Paste both here. Qualified leads get a tag your automations can trigger on.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Cal.com
item.description: Visitors book your Cal.com events from a magnet. Each booking is added to the lead. Works on every Cal.com plan, including free. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then Cal.com. Then: In Cal.com, go to Settings, then Developer, then API keys, and create a key. Paste the key here. Booking sync is set up automatically. Turn on Cal.com booking for any magnet, in the Book call-to-action under Magnets.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and CallRail
item.description: Every tracked phone call becomes a lead automatically, complete with recording and source. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Integrations, then CallRail. Then: In CallRail, go to Integrations, then Data access, then API keys, and create a key. Read-only works for calls; Allow Writes lets us set up call sync automatically. Paste the key here and pick the account and company this workspace tracks. Calls start landing in your Leads inbox within minutes.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Webhook
item.description: Send every captured and qualified lead to your own endpoint as signed JSON. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Notifications. Then: In the app, go to Settings, then Notifications. Add your endpoint URL and an optional signing secret, then save. Click Send test to confirm delivery. Leads arrive as JSON with an HMAC signature header. What syncs Every captured and qualified lead is sent to your own endpoint as signed JSON.

item.title: Mach Five Magnet and Zapier
item.description: Connect a Zapier zap to the Magnet webhook and send leads to thousands of apps. Set up Open the app and go to Settings, then Notifications. Then: In Zapier, create a zap with the Webhooks by Zapier trigger and choose Catch Hook. Copy the hook URL into the app under Settings, then Notifications, then save. Click Send test, then map the lead fields in your zap. What syncs Connect a Zapier zap to the Magnet webhook and send leads to thousands of apps.

item.description: Questions about pricing, agencies, or getting a magnet on your site? Start the conversation below. Prefer email? hello@machfivemagnet.com.

item.title: Magnet for B2B Lead Gen
item.description: Long forms kill conversion. Short forms miss context. You know the tradeoff. A long form gets you qualified leads but tanks your conversion rate. A short form gets volume but buries your team in unqualified noise. Magnet eliminates the tradeoff. A conversational flow collects the same information as a 10-field form, but each question builds on the last. It feels fast because it’s relevant. The prospect doesn’t think “I’m filling out a form.

item.title: Magnet for B2B SaaS
item.description: The problem with SaaS demo forms Your visitor clicks “Book a Demo.” They see a form with 8 fields. Name, email, company, role, company size, use case, timeline, budget. They fill in three and leave. You never hear from them. Magnet replaces that form with a quick conversation. Two or three questions, branched based on their answers, and they’re looking at a calendar. The whole thing takes 30 seconds. How SaaS teams use Magnet Demo booking flows that qualify while they convert.

item.title: Magnet for E-Commerce
item.description: Shoppers don’t want to search. They want to be shown. Product catalogs are overwhelming. Filters help, but most visitors don’t know what they’re filtering for. A product quiz asks three questions and recommends the right item. It feels like talking to a knowledgeable associate, not using a search engine. How e-commerce stores use Magnet Product recommendation quizzes that guide shoppers to the right item. “What’s the occasion?” “What’s your budget?” “Do you prefer classic or modern?

item.title: Magnet for Professional Services
item.description: Your contact form doesn’t tell you anything useful “Name, email, message.” That’s what most service firm contact pages collect. Then someone on your team has to email back, ask qualifying questions, go back and forth, and eventually schedule a call. That’s three days of friction for what could be a 30-second conversation. How service firms use Magnet Consultation booking flows that collect context before the meeting. What do they need help with?
